# Security policy

This repository publishes documentation and historical source evidence. It
does not ship or support an OpenRig runtime.

Do not post credentials, private prompts, personal details, private repository
identities, or sensitive paths in a public issue. If this repository itself
publishes sensitive information, use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting
feature when available. Otherwise request a private contact channel without
including sensitive details.

Runtime vulnerabilities in historical OpenRig evidence belong to the
maintainer of the affected current product. Do not run the archived source to
produce a report for this learning repository.
